author: BlackTecCom - Jaborov Daler
changelog: Safe uninstaller: ApplicationRemovalService strictly prevents deletion of Windows, Program Files, and user root directories
Dynamic migration partitions: OsMigrationService dynamically finds free letters, cleans up temporary volumes, and prevents Robocopy deadlocks
Zip Slip security: GUI ArchiveService validates extracted paths against directory traversal attacks
CopyEngine enhancements: SkipCurrent cancels active file transfers immediately; isolated per-file error handling prevents queue failures; exact size verification
File management safety: FileSystemService routes deletions to Windows Recycle Bin by default
Memory optimization: Crc32Verifier uses ArrayPool to eliminate Large Object Heap (LOH) allocations
Repository hygiene: removed dead code, purged tracked test artifacts, fixed startup string formatting and duplicate privilege escalations
